metadata.title: Sharp modified logarithmic Sobolev inequality for matrix-valued functions on spheres
metadata.abstract: We prove that for every smooth positive definite matrix-valued function $g$ on the unit sphere $S^d$, \[ \int_{S^d}\tr(g(\log g-\log\E g))\dd \le\dfrac1{2d}\int_{S^d}\tr((\Delta g)\log g)\dd. \] Here $\mu$ is normalized area measure, $\E g$ is the spherical mean, and $\Delta$ is the positive spherical Laplacian. This complete modified logarithmic Sobolev inequality extends Beckner's sharp logarithmic Sobolev inequality, in its modified form, to matrix-valued functions independent of the matrix size. We show that both entropy and Fisher information decay exponentially under the heat flow with optimal exponent $2d$, whose proof combines the Bochner identity with a $4$th-tensor estimate in the matrix-valued setting.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.progressType: 球面矩阵值函数的尖锐修正对数 Sobolev 不等式
analysis.workSummary: 设 d≥2，g 为单位球面 Sᵈ 上任意尺寸的光滑正定复矩阵场。对归一化球面测度和正 Laplacian Δ，矩阵相对熵 D(g‖Eg) 满足 D≤I/(2d)，其中 I=∫tr((Δg)log g) dμ。逐分量热半群使 D 和 I 都至多按 e^(−2dt) 衰减。
techniques: BKM 矩阵内积的联合凸性
四阶熵张量的无迹估计
加权 Bochner 恒等式与 Hessian 配方
热半群积分与球面一次谐波
固定矩阵均值的 Herbst 估计与 Clifford 矩阵
analysis.breakthrough: 定理6将 −I′/2−dI 控制为非负配方及四阶余项。相较仅用 Ric=(d−1)g 的耗散基准，保留 Hessian 迹并用张量不等式吸收无迹误差，得到常数 d。一次球谐的小扰动限制最优衰减指数。对逐点满足 Σ(∂ⱼF)²≤V 的 Hermitian 场，另得带任意 Hermitian 平移的迹 Laplace 界。
analysis.limitations: 定理1、6、7的证明范围是 d≥2。第2页将 d=1 的尖锐矩阵结论归于既有工作。浓缩的 Clifford 例证实统一的二次系数尖锐，尾界前因子的最优性未在定理主张内。补核定理与配方路线，未独立证明全部非交换张量恒等式。
